goat_desc: I am a curious goat. I love climbing and I say 'maa'.
goat_fun_fact_1: The pupils of my eyes are shaped like rectangles.
goat_fun_fact_2: I am a great climber, even on steep rocks.
goat_fun_fact_3: A baby goat is called a kid.
parrot_desc: I am a colorful parrot. I love to chat and copy sounds.
parrot_fun_fact_1: I can copy the words and sounds I hear.
parrot_fun_fact_2: I hold my food with my foot, just like a hand.
parrot_fun_fact_3: Two of my toes point forward and two point backward.
rabbit_desc: I am a fluffy rabbit. I hop around and love to nibble on greens.
rabbit_fun_fact_2: I can turn my long ears toward a sound.
rabbit_fun_fact_3: When I am very happy, I jump and twist in the air.
chicken_desc: I am a chicken. I live on the farm, lay eggs and say 'cluck cluck'.
chicken_habitat: Farms and gardens all around the world
chicken_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, grains, worms and insects
chicken_fun_fact_1: I am a bird, but I can only fly a short way.
chicken_fun_fact_2: I talk to my chicks while they are still inside the egg.
chicken_fun_fact_3: I take dust baths to keep my feathers clean.
donkey_desc: I am a friendly donkey. I have long ears and I say 'hee-haw'.
donkey_fun_fact_1: My long ears help me hear sounds from far away.
donkey_fun_fact_2: I have a great memory and remember my friends for years.
donkey_fun_fact_3: My loud 'hee-haw' can be heard from very far away.
turkey_desc: I am a turkey. I strut around and say 'gobble gobble'.
turkey_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, nuts, berries and insects
turkey_fun_fact_1: Wild turkeys like me can fly short distances.
turkey_fun_fact_2: Only male turkeys make the 'gobble gobble' sound.
turkey_fun_fact_3: In the wild, I sleep up in the trees at night.
goose_desc: I am a goose. I love to swim and I say 'honk honk'.
goose_diet: Herbivorous. Grass, seeds and water plants
goose_fun_fact_1: My friends and I fly together in a V shape.
goose_fun_fact_2: I am a good guard and honk loudly when strangers come.
goose_fun_fact_3: My babies can swim just one day after hatching.
eagle_desc: I am a mighty eagle. I soar high up in the sky.
eagle_fun_fact_1: My eyes are very sharp; I can spot tiny things from high up.
eagle_fun_fact_2: I build huge nests high up in trees or on cliffs.
eagle_fun_fact_3: I can glide for a long time without flapping my wings.
crow_desc: I am a clever crow. I have shiny black feathers and say 'caw caw'.
crow_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, fruits, insects and leftovers
crow_fun_fact_1: I am very smart and can use sticks as tools.
crow_fun_fact_3: I hide food so I can eat it later.
seagull_desc: I am a seagull. I fly over the sea and call out loudly.
seagull_diet: Omnivorous. Fish, crabs, insects and leftovers
seagull_fun_fact_1: I can drink salty sea water.
seagull_fun_fact_2: I stamp my feet on the grass to make worms come up.
seagull_fun_fact_3: I can float on the wind almost without flapping my wings.
cuckoo_desc: I am a cuckoo. In spring you can hear me calling 'cuckoo' in the woods.
cuckoo_fun_fact_1: My name comes from my call: 'cuckoo'.
cuckoo_fun_fact_3: I fly to warm Africa for the winter and come back in spring.
hippo_desc: I am a big hippo. I love to stay in the water all day.
hippo_diet: Herbivorous. I eat grass, mostly at night.
hippo_fun_fact_1: I stay in the water most of the day to keep cool.
hippo_fun_fact_2: My eyes, ears and nose sit on the very top of my head.
hippo_fun_fact_3: I don't really swim; I walk along the river bottom.
rhino_desc: I am a strong rhino. I have a horn on my nose and thick skin.
rhino_habitat: Grasslands and forests of Africa and Asia
rhino_fun_fact_1: My horn is made of the same stuff as your fingernails.
rhino_fun_fact_2: I roll in mud to protect my skin from the sun.
rhino_fun_fact_3: I can't see very well, but I smell and hear very well.
hyena_desc: I am a hyena. My call sounds like I am laughing.
hyena_diet: Carnivorous. I eat meat and can even chew bones.
hyena_fun_fact_1: My call sounds just like giggling.
hyena_fun_fact_2: In my family, the females are the leaders.
hyena_fun_fact_3: I live in a big family called a clan.
deer_desc: I am a gentle deer. I live in the forest and run very fast.
deer_fun_fact_1: Father deer grow brand new antlers every year.
deer_fun_fact_2: As a baby, I have white spots that help me hide.
deer_fun_fact_3: I can turn my ears toward a sound without moving my head.
panda_desc: I am a cuddly panda. I am black and white and I love bamboo.
panda_habitat: Bamboo forests in the mountains of China
panda_diet: I eat almost nothing but bamboo.
panda_fun_fact_1: I spend most of my day eating bamboo.
panda_fun_fact_2: When I am born, I am tiny and pink.
panda_fun_fact_3: I have a special 'thumb' for holding bamboo.
seal_desc: I am a playful seal. I swim fast and rest on the shore.
seal_fun_fact_1: A thick layer of fat keeps me warm in cold water.
seal_fun_fact_2: My whiskers help me find fish in dark water.
seal_fun_fact_3: I can sleep in the water.
walrus_desc: I am a big walrus. I have long tusks and a bushy mustache.
walrus_diet: Clams, snails and other sea creatures
walrus_fun_fact_1: My long tusks are really giant teeth.
walrus_fun_fact_2: I use my tusks to pull myself up onto the ice.
walrus_fun_fact_3: My whiskers help me find clams on the sea floor.
cricket_desc: I am a tiny cricket. I sing 'chirp chirp' on summer evenings.
cricket_diet: Omnivorous. Leaves, seeds, fruits and tiny insects
cricket_fun_fact_1: I sing by rubbing my wings together.
cricket_fun_fact_2: My ears are on my front legs.
cricket_fun_fact_3: I sing faster when the weather is warm.
mouse_desc: I am a little mouse. I am quick and I say 'squeak squeak'.
mouse_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, grains, fruits and insects
mouse_fun_fact_1: I use my whiskers to feel my way in the dark.
mouse_fun_fact_2: I can squeeze through very tiny holes.
mouse_fun_fact_3: I sing songs that are too high for people to hear.
peacock_desc: I am a proud peacock. I spread my colorful tail like a fan.
peacock_habitat: Forests and gardens of South Asia
peacock_diet: Omnivorous. Seeds, fruits, flowers and insects
peacock_fun_fact_1: Only we males have the long, colorful tail feathers.
peacock_fun_fact_2: My tail feathers have patterns that look like eyes.
peacock_fun_fact_3: I can fly, even with my long tail.
pigeon_desc: I am a pigeon. I live in cities and parks and say 'coo coo'.
pigeon_fun_fact_1: I can find my way home from very far away.
pigeon_fun_fact_2: Long ago, people used me to carry letters.
pigeon_fun_fact_3: I bob my head back and forth when I walk.
swan_desc: I am a graceful swan. I glide across the lake with my long neck.
swan_diet: Herbivorous. Water plants, grass and seeds
swan_fun_fact_1: I stay with the same partner for many years.
swan_fun_fact_2: My babies are gray and fluffy, not white.
swan_fun_fact_3: I carry my babies on my back while I swim.
squirrel_desc: I am a quick squirrel. I leap from branch to branch and collect nuts.
squirrel_fun_fact_1: The nuts I forget to dig up can grow into new trees.
squirrel_fun_fact_2: My bushy tail helps me balance and keeps me warm.
squirrel_fun_fact_3: I can climb down a tree head first.
